blocks.en: Unfortunately, estimates on boundary terms are rather delicate, so we will put off this subject until the next section. In the meantime, we will concentrate on interior estimates of higher-order derivatives. For example, let $\Omega^{\prime}$ be any domain such that $\Omega^{\prime}\subset\subset\Omega$. (The notation $\Omega^{\prime}\subset\subset\Omega$ means that $\Omega^{\prime}$ is compactly contained in the open set $\Omega$; i.e., $\overline{\Omega^{\prime}}$ is compact and $\overline{\Omega^{\prime}}\subset\Omega$.) We now choose a cutoff function $\zeta\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ such that $0\leq\zeta\leq1$ and $\zeta\equiv1$ on $\Omega^{\prime}$. We can now make some calculations very similar to those above, but without any boundary terms getting in the way.
blocks.zh: 遗憾的是, 边界项的估计相当细致, 因此将这个问题推迟到下一节. 先集中考虑高阶导数的内部估计. 例如, 设 $\Omega^{\prime}$ 为任意满足 $\Omega^{\prime}\subset\subset\Omega$ 的区域. (记号 $\Omega^{\prime}\subset\subset\Omega$ 表示 $\Omega^{\prime}$ 紧含于开集 $\Omega$; 即 $\overline{\Omega^{\prime}}$ 紧且 $\overline{\Omega^{\prime}}\subset\Omega$.) 现在选取截断函数 $\zeta\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, 使 $0\leq\zeta\leq1$, 且在 $\Omega^{\prime}$ 上 $\zeta\equiv1$. 于是可以进行与前面十分相似的计算, 而没有边界项的干扰.

blocks.en: Thus, we have an estimate on the $H^2(\Omega^{\prime})$ norm of a solution $u$ for any $\Omega^{\prime}\subset\subset\Omega$ in terms of the $L^2(\Omega)$ of the data $f$ and the $H^1(\Omega)$ norm of $u$. Of course, one of the major objections to the calculations performed above is that we needed to make unwarranted assumptions about the smoothness of the solution $u$ in order to perform the integrations by parts involved. In the rigorous version of these calculations below, these operations are replaced by analogous techniques involving difference quotients. Because the technique of using difference quotients is so important in this section, we present the following brief discussion of this topic.
blocks.zh: 因此, 对任意 $\Omega^{\prime}\subset\subset\Omega$, 都得到了用数据 $f$ 的 $L^2(\Omega)$ 和 $u$ 的 $H^1(\Omega)$ 范数控制解 $u$ 的 $H^2(\Omega^{\prime})$ 范数的估计. 当然, 对上述计算的一个主要异议是, 为进行其中的分部积分, 必须对解 $u$ 的光滑性作未经论证的假设. 在下面这些计算的严格版本中, 将用涉及差商的类似技巧替代这些操作. 由于差商技巧在本节十分重要, 下面对这一主题作简要讨论.
